_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Friday — policy capstone of Glasswing week + CoreWeave compute-consolidation play. (1) CoreWeave-Anthropic $6.8B multi-year deal for Claude production GPU; nine of top-ten model providers on CoreWeave; two-day total ~$28B; stock +12%. Anthropic's compute lanes diversify: AWS training + Google TPU + CoreWeave NVIDIA GPU. (2) Bessent + Powell convene Wall Street CEOs at Treasury HQ — Fortune breaks 10 Apr — Fraser/Pick/Moynihan/Scharf/Solomon attending. First time U.S. financial regulators have convened bank-CEO class around a single named frontier AI model. (3) Bloomberg 'why Anthropic's new AI has officials worried' becomes most-read 10 Apr Mythos explainer; gating-as-policy-intervention frame quoted by Treasury + BoE staff briefings the following week. (4) Bank of England FPC publishes parallel April session with NCSC — Mythos-class systemic-risk testing playbook becomes Anglo-American by Friday afternoon. (5) Fortune 'era of AI-driven hacking already here' — policy response shifts from preventive (gating) to compensatory (defender uplift via Project Glasswing alumni-network expansion). Plus: MarketingProfs week-recap calls this 'most-consequential single week in AI policy and capability disclosure since GPT-5'; Mistral 3 schedule for late April; Simon Willison 'Voice mode is weaker' via Karpathy crystallises capability-gap-by-access-point thesis. Research: Master Key Hypothesis (post-trained capability in low-dim latent subspace, transferable across model scales by linear alignment — if true, dramatically changes post-training economics); MolmoWeb (open-weight web agent on screenshots only); SkillClaw (multi-user agent ecosystem with autonomous evolver aggregating per-user interactions into shared skill repository); Externalization in LLM Agents (cleanest taxonomy of agent stack as memory + skills + protocols + harness); Structured Distillation with Gemini 3 Pro as teacher in agent-as-annotator pipeline; Act Wisely / HDPO (most agentic-multimodal failures are meta-cognitive); Graph of Skills (executable skill graph with reverse-weighted Personalized PageRank); Rethinking Generalization in Reasoning SFT (asymmetric SFT-vs-RL cross-domain generalization, 'dip-and-recovery' pattern in long-CoT training tracks reasoning vs safety tradeoff).
